title: Practice: a retry policy, graded on scripted failures (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 overloaded twice then success returns the good reply after two waits
cases.says: Overloaded twice, then success: the good reply comes back after waits of 0.5 and 1.0

cases.id: e1 client errors are not retried
e2 retry after is a floor for the wait
cases.says: retry-after is a floor for the wait

cases.id: e3 delay doubles up to the cap and the jitter is applied last
cases.says: The delay doubles up to the cap, and the jitter is applied last

cases.id: e4 a spend cap 429 is not retried
e5 connection errors are retried like server errors
cases.says: Connection errors are retried like server errors, and give connection_error at the end

cases.id: e6 giving up reports the last reply and does not wait after the last attempt
cases.says: Giving up reports the last reply, makes exactly max_attempts calls and waits one time fewer
